name: Novartis
notes: revenue = 'Net sales (to third parties)' (from continuing operations where split); operatingIncome = 'Operating income'. FY ends Dec 31. Novartis reported in CHF until 2002 and switched to USD from 1 Jan 2003; 2000-2001 are the company's own USD restatements in the FY2003 20-F (group scope at the time, incl. later-divested units), 2002-2006 from FY2006 20-F (Medical Nutrition as discontinued), 2007-2011 from FY2011 20-F (Medical Nutrition and Gerber discontinued), 2012-2016 from FY2016 20-F (restated for 2014-15 portfolio transformation: Vaccines/OTC/Animal Health discontinued), 2017-2018 as originally reported incl. Alcon (spun off Apr 2019), 2019-2020 excl. Alcon, 2021-2022 as reported incl. Sandoz, 2023-2025 excl. Sandoz (spun off Oct 2023). Series mixes restatement scopes; step changes at 2002/2003 boundary (FY2003 20-F gave 2003 sales 24,864 vs 24,049 in FY2006 20-F), 2018->2019 (Alcon) and 2022->2023 (Sandoz) are scope changes, not organic. 2004 operatingIncome is the FY2006 20-F '2004 pro forma' column (restated for IFRS standards adopted 1 Jan 2005, comparable with 2005-2006; audited non-pro-forma 2004 was 6,117). FY2000-2002 omitted: originally reported in CHF.
